name: NP CeraVe Blemish Control Face Cleanser 2% Salicylic Acid Niacinamide Acne 8 oz
description:
Gentle cleanser for blemish-prone skin

Refreshing gel-to-foam facial cleanser for blemish-prone skin, that helps to reduce the appearance of blemishes and blackheads, and removes excess oil while leaving the skin feeling soft and smooth. The formula penetrates pores to eliminate the cause of spots & blemishes, while respecting the skin’s natural barrier.
